newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia's bourse closes at record highs.
newsitem.headline: Estonia's bourse closes at record highs.

text.p: Estonia's bullish bourse was propelled to new highs again on Wednesday by a big deal in industrial group Norma and solid gains in Hansapank and Hoiupank.
While stocks across Europe smashed new records, dealers said the market was responding to domestic stimuli and not mirroring trends elsewhere.

A deal worth 121 million kroons in Norma, as parent company Norma Group sold 11.9 percent of its shares to Western institutional investors, helped the market close with record turnover of 178.8 million kroons.
The bourse index rose to a new high of 314.66, up 2.49 percent.
Norma ended up 2.70 kroons at 83.70 kroons.
Leading banks Hansapank and Hoiupank also hit new levels in modest trade. Both closed at 178 kroons, a rise of 4.80 kroons for Hansapank and a gain of 6.6 kroons for Hoiu.
"It would be logical for investors to start profit-taking at this high level but speculation on profit revisions are keeping them waiting at these positions," a dealer said.
After positive first-half results, many investors expect the two banks to increase their forecasts for full-year profits.
